result.name: auth_rls_initplan
result.title: Auth RLS Initialization Plan
result.description: Detects if calls to `current_setting()` and `auth.<function>()` in RLS policies are being unnecessarily re-evaluated for each row
result.detail: Table `public.projects` has a row level security policy `fixture_project_access` that re-evaluates current_setting() or auth.<function>() for each row. This produces suboptimal query performance at scale. Resolve the issue by replacing `auth.<function>()` with `(select auth.<function>())`. See [docs](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/postgres/row-level-security#call-functions-with-select) for more info.

scope: Inspect owned project forests and exact contents/epochs
Explicit collaborator decisions and effective after-access
HMAC-reviewed atomic adoption with durable exact-request receipt
Preserved eligible assignment provenance and source identities
Canonical Auth/team/epoch locks, NOWAIT source locks and private cutover fences
Personal service post-lock custody recheck and team webhook capture exclusion
Read-committed requirement for transfer and personal ownership-at-commit validation
limits: No native review/recovery implementation or new app build/runtime acceptance in this stage
Source-only flag native_project_adoption_enabled defaults false; only disposable fixtures enable it
Provider/unknown root or nested attachments and personal email/project/global webhook bindings block adoption until explicit custody/pause adapters exist
Full hosted integration/storage/account/window/spoken/keyboard/layout and provider delivery acceptance remains open

Owned minimal pre-inspected Auth/task/collaboration dependency snapshots remain; actual hierarchy, assignment, guarded move, email/domain and webhook/outbox migrations load unchanged except the committed new guards
No automatic Undo for custody transfer; returning to personal is a separate future operation
All user-deferred release/signing/distribution, remote push, older-client rollout, OAuth/provider registration and physical location items remain deferred
diagnostics: Corrected test invitation setup order and loaded the actual hierarchy prerequisites
Missing assigned_to after clearing is tested as JSON null rather than SQL-null parser output
Oversized request input is constructed inside PostgreSQL to avoid the OS argument-length limit
The ordinary 16 KiB team envelope could not honor the documented access-decision capacity; a private 256 KiB shape validator now passes an actual 1000-collaborator inspect/review/adopt case
Actual domain-binding schema required a synthetic alias_domain in the route fixture
Final independent runs have no failures or skipped checks; owned containers removed even on diagnostic failures
